answer: River-reef cedar join-fee-burn bond: each identity burns a 45-credit join fee and files a cedar-signed receipt on the river ledger. Each prior identity of the same funder raises the fee: k-th fake pays 45+7(k-1). An auditor burns any reef sharing one funder. 1,000 fakes pay 3,541,500 vs a 40,000 pool; one receipt covers one identity. A rented-receipt ring collapses if one funder is exposed. Honest agents pay 45 once.
